kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أفتضح (form VIII)
# أَفْتَضِحُ (ʔaftaḍiḥu) /ʔaf.ta.dˤi.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِفْتَضَحَ (iftaḍaḥa)
# أَفْتَضِحَ (ʔaftaḍiḥa) /ʔaf.ta.dˤi.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَضَحَ (iftaḍaḥa)
# أَفْتَضِحْ (ʔaftaḍiḥ) /ʔaf.ta.dˤiħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِفْتَضَحَ (iftaḍaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
